input.contract_name: Janitorial Services, U.S. Coast Guard Training Center Port Arden, Alabama
input.notes: Amendment 0001 (21-Oct-2026). Period of performance: one 12-month base period and four 12-month option periods (A5). Janitorial only: grounds maintenance, refuse collection and pest control are under separate contracts (TE-5 para 5.3; ~418 acres). Pricing basis is Service Area SF (column 6), not Gross SF (A6, Notes 1-2). Climate inferred from Alabama. Quotations due 06-Nov-2026, 2:00 PM CT.

input.summary: USCG Training Center Port Arden janitorial services (70Z08427QTCPA0019, Amendment 0001 conformed TE-5). Registered all 34 printed TE-5 rows: 31 buildings in scope (Service Area 381,210 SF; Gross 799,515 SF), T-47 deleted by A0001, Bldg 41 vacant, Bldg 118 option-only (CLIN 0005). Registered the 4 information-only rows of para 5.4 as excluded. Gross SF recorded as gross_area and Service Area SF (pricing basis per A6) as cleanable_area. No grounds in scope (separate contract). Prior award: Seawall Facility Services, LLC, 70Z08422CTCPA0007, $5,862,340 / 60 months, awarded Sep 2022.
